recipient: Avi Dichter / FADC; government ministry, IDF, Home Front and emergency representatives
warning_summary: Northern local/emergency leaders warned that current preparations matched 2006 rather than newer Hezbollah ground-attack and precision-fire reference scenarios; communities could be seized for hours and left to cope alone despite evacuation, medical, fire and communications gaps.
evidence_update: Official contemporaneous Knesset record directly documents warning delivery and responses. A June 2017 PMO announcement later funded operation of the Kiryat Shmona forward emergency room, addressing one sub-gap. Published to Notion.
gaps: Northern-front readiness warning, not an October 7 attack prediction. Government and IDF representatives said some plans already existed; the broader preparedness gaps were not shown to have been fully resolved.
